name: NC191LTA10
notes: The manufacturer's curve at every point the manufacturer states: 90 C at 90 s, 130 C at 180 s, liquidus 137 C at 210 s, peak 165 C at 240 s, back through 137 C at 270 s. Process-interchangeable with TS391LT: the same chart shape, one degree apart at liquidus. Only the opening is this oven's own, for the reason given in TS391LT's notes -- the digitised chart asked 1.33 C/s from cold against about 0.58 measured, and the oven spent the first ninety seconds first behind the curve and then ahead of it. THE DOOR MUST BE OPENED AT PEAK, and when matters as much as whether: run 0006 opened it 26 s late and finished at 98 s against a 90 s ceiling; run 0007 opened it on the prompt and finished at 76 s. The oven asks when opening it will land time above liquidus mid-window, and counts down to it. Paste needs 4 hours out of the fridge to reach 20-25 C before use.
reference: Chip Quik NC191LTA10 datasheet, Recommended Profile chart (Sn42/Bi57/Ag1, mp 137 C); opening ramp generated from data/oven-characterisation.json
